keyway = Pos(0, 0, wall_thickness - keyway_depth / 2) * Box(keyway_width, keyway_length, keyway_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - keyway

for i in range(hole_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    px = hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, height / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, height + 1)

vertical_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
solid_body = chamfer(vertical_edges, chamfer_dist)

part = solid_body
part.name = "tapered_cup_with_keyway"
export_step(part, "output.step")
